steps.title: Analyze Build Failure
steps.description: Inspect the Gradle error log showing an XML stream syntax error on line 200 of activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Identify Root Cause
steps.description: Pinpoint the unescaped double quotes inside the android:text attribute of the footer TextView.

steps.title: Repair Layout XML Syntax
steps.description: Modify activity_main.xml to use proper XML entity escaping (") for quotes within attribute values.

steps.title: Optimize Build Dependencies
steps.description: Remove unused third-party NanoHTTPD dependency from build.gradle to ensure safe and lightweight compilation.

steps.title: Verify Layout Integrity
steps.description: Ensure the revised XML layout is completely well-formed and can be compiled correctly by AAPT.

steps.title: Validate Java Code
steps.description: Ensure MainActivity.java has no broken imports or unresolved references and remains Java 8 compatible.

steps.title: Verify Manifest Settings
steps.description: Confirm AndroidManifest.xml continues to refer to the correct namespace and package settings.

steps.title: Clean Build Cache
steps.description: Perform checks to clean temporary artifacts and intermediate resource caches.

steps.title: Verify Build Compatibility
steps.description: Ensure build tools compile code to match target SDK 34 and JVM compatibility.

steps.title: Building How To Be Best
steps.description: Run final project assembly to generate the corrected debug APK build without errors.
